name: notes
description: A notes and knowledge base app. Next.js App Router, Drizzle, Better Auth, optimistic TanStack Query UI.

pins._: JSON has no comments, so the two deliberate below-latest pins are explained here. See ADR 0002, docs/decisions/0002-pin-typescript-and-eslint-below-latest.md.
pins.typescript: 6.0.3, not 7.x: typescript-eslint 8.x (a dependency of eslint-config-next) peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. TypeScript 7 makes pnpm lint impossible to run. Revisit when typescript-eslint 9 ships.
pins.eslint: 9.39.5, not 10.x: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 (a dependency of eslint-config-next) peers eslint ^9.7. Revisit when eslint-plugin-react supports eslint 10.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:docs && pnpm test:run
